mapper.select: SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.TITLE AS GROUP_TITLE, g.STATUS AS GROUP_STATUS, g.OWNER_ID, gm.STATUS AS MEMBER_STATUS, gm.WARNING_COUNT FROM GYE_GROUP g LEFT JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = #{targetMemberId} WHERE g.GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE GYE_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'EXPELLED', LEFT_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{targetMemberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND WARNING_COUNT = 2
mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SANCTION ( SANCTION_ID, SANCTION_TYPE, MEMBER_ID, GROUP_ID, ISSUED_MEMBER_ID, ISSUED_ADMIN_ID, REASON, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_SANCTION.NEXTVAL, #{sanctionType}, #{targetMemberId}, #{groupId}, #{issuedMemberId}, NULL, #{reason}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{actorMemberId}, NULL, #{targetMemberId}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
